info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-Create Education Enrollments Create-v3-spec
info.description: The Education Enrollment Management API streamlines the process of enrolling students in educational programs. This endpoint allows authorized users to create new student enrollment records, ensuring that necessary information is captured efficiently. Typical users of this API include educational institutions, administrative staff, and software developers working on student management systems. By integrating this API, institutions can enhance their enrollment processes and improve data accuracy.

post.description: This endpoint allows the user to create a new enrollment record in the system. Provide the necessary details in the request body to complete the enrollment process.

requestBody.description: Request body for creating a new enrollment. This must contain all the necessary details for the enrollment process. Ensure that the data is correctly formatted as specified in the schema.

201.description: The enrollment was created successfully, and the resource location is provided in the response.
